## WF-15: CRM & OAuth Sync (U004)
Đồng bộ dữ liệu Lead inbound từ CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, v.v.) qua Webhook -> Chuẩn hóa họ tên, email, công ty -> Upsert vào bảng `leads` trong PostgreSQL.

**Setup:** Cần thiết lập credential *Postgres account* kết nối vào database `ai_sales_agent`.
**Endpoint:** POST `/webhook/crm-inbound-sync`

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO leads (
  organization_id,
  external_source,
  external_id,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  company_name,
  email,
  phone,
  source,
  status,
  updated_at
)
VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM organizations LIMIT 1),
  '{{ $json.external_source }}',
  '{{ $json.external_id }}',
  '{{ $json.first_name }}',
  '{{ $json.last_name }}',
  '{{ $json.company_name }}',
  '{{ $json.email }}',
  '{{ $json.phone }}',
  '{{ $json.source }}',
  '{{ $json.status }}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (organization_id, external_source, external_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name,
  last_name = EXCLUDED.last_name,
  company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name,
  email = EXCLUDED.email,
  phone = EXCLUDED.phone,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, external_id, email, status;
